title: Billing Review Table: Fitting the Commercial Natural Gas Supply Shortfall Lower End to Cycle Length
content:
In the correction of a Commercial Natural Gas Supply swing shortfall charge line, the lower end against which the shortfall is measured is fitted to the length of the billing cycle. The length is counted in days from the billing period start to the billing period end with both ends included. The fitting acts on the lower end as it stands after every reduction made to the billed lower end.

| Cycle length | Fitted lower end |
|---|---|
| Shorter than 28 days | The lower end multiplied by the cycle's days and divided by 30 |
| From 28 to 32 days | The lower end unchanged |
| Longer than 32 days | The lower end multiplied by the cycle's days and by 12, and divided by 365 |

The fitted lower end is rounded half up to a whole therm, and the correct shortfall therms are measured against it.

## Fitted figures (hypothetical lower end of 1,000 therms)

| Billing period | Days, both ends included | Fitted lower end |
|---|---|---|
| 2025-02-01 to 2025-02-25 | 25 | 1,000 multiplied by 25 and divided by 30 is 833.33: 833 therms |
| 2025-02-01 to 2025-02-27 | 27 | 900 therms |
| 2025-02-01 to 2025-02-28 | 28 | 1,000 therms, unchanged |
| 2025-03-01 to 2025-04-01 | 32 | 1,000 therms, unchanged |
| 2025-03-01 to 2025-04-02 | 33 | 1,000 multiplied by 33 and by 12 and divided by 365 is 1,084.93: 1,085 therms |
| 2025-01-01 to 2025-02-04 | 35 | 1,150.68: 1,151 therms |
